rationale: These headers and sources are in the Vellum export. Each gains a PULP_GPU_RUNTIME forwarding branch or takes its forward declarations from pulp/platform/gpu_fwd.hpp, with the original bodies kept in the #else branch, and gpu_runtime_hooks.cpp and gpu_fwd.hpp are new.
